name: Jane Kreusler-Walsh
tagline: Top rated Appellate attorney in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida

about: Jane Kreusler-Walsh is Board Certified as a specialist in appellate practice, the highest level of recognition by The Florida Bar of an attorney's competency and experience in a specific area of law. Ms. Kreusler-Walsh focuses on civil appeals and litigation support involving complex commercial, medical malpractice, personal injury, product liability, class action, insurance, securities, marital and family law, and probate and trust law issues.

Ms. Kreusler-Walsh is admitted to practice in all Florida state courts, the U.S. Supreme Court, the U.S. Courts of Appeals for the 4th Circuit, and the U.S. District Courts for the Middle and Southern Districts of Florida. She has more than 500 reported decisions to date.

Ms. Kreusler-Walsh has a long record of service to the bar and is an active member of several professional organizations. She is the Vice Chair of The Florida Bar Civil Procedure Rules Committee. She holds an AV Preeminent* peer review rating through Martindale-Hubbell and has received numerous honors and awards. Ms. Kreusler-Walsh is one of only 14 Florida fellows in the American Academy of Appellate Attorneys, a national invitation-only organization founded to advance the highest standards and practices of appellate advocacy and to recognize outstanding appellate attorneys. Chambers USA 2017 ranks Ms. Kreusler-Walsh as among the top 13 appellate attorneys in Florida.

*AV Preeminent and BV Distinguished are certification marks of Reed Elsevier Properties Inc., used in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell peer review ratings fall into two categories: legal ability and general ethical standards.
